'''A New Hope through Cloud City rules supplements (Scrye 4.5)''' is the January 1998 ''[[Scrye]]'' 4.5 magazine insert of a 10-page booklet. The booklet reprints the rules supplements from [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] through [[Cloud City Limited|Cloud City]] and a Cloud City card checklist.<ref name="enc183">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=183 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 183–184 (Magazine Coverage). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="enc20mag">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/SWCCG+Collecting+Encyclopedia+2.0.pdf#page=50 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 2.0], pp. 50–52 (Magazine Promotions). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261024031553/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/SWCCG+Collecting+Encyclopedia+2.0.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
